notesArr.text:
Did the session Tuesday night after beachvolley.
Didn’t like either of the standing cable rear delt or triceps pushdown - they didn’t work as a superset for me, and I think I prefer triceps extensions over head for the triceps, although if it’s in order to target more than just the triceps I’m not against, as long as the super set works
Played tennis before working out, thus the knee 1,5-2. Wondering if there is too little deadlifting/lower back exercises in the full program
I was sick all last week, first session in a while.

We should add right shoulder to the check in list - it’s been hurting for a while (10 days or so). I suspect my hitting technique in beach volley is part of the equation, not letting the whip but rather the shoulder rotation produce the power. I am working on that part. The band shoulder warm up is really good for me, and I believe the pull-heavier workout is good. I was ill all last week so didn’t get around to it.
Leg extensions have no guided kilos, should be fixed.

I always do the harmstring curls one leg at a time to make sure my left doesn’t hide the weakness of my right harmstring. So Kgs are basically half of what I have logged, but one legged.
I’m not super comfortable with kettle bell swings - don’t think Inhave great technique. Is it worth investing in to get the technique down, or is there a good replacement just as good?
Slept on a foldable mattress, so stiff body.
I did a barbell military push (22.5kg) and not the dumbbell shoulder push as a superset with bicep curls (20kg) which I quite enjoyed.

I have had issues with my right shoulder the last week. I think we need to implement exercises where I can improve my volleyball swing mechanic, so it’s the whip and not the shoulder rotation that generates power. Maybe as part of the warm up on push and pull days along side the band exercises for the rotator cuff.
Also a bit of a pinch in right groin/hip flexor
Stopped nicotine yesterday, so energy in my body, slept 12 hours, will probably take some time getting back from energy wise.

The single leg rdl is not specific enough on which version it is - one dumbbell? Two? Opposite hand? What is it chasing? I won’t do it until I know what it’s supposed to do.
Also, is the deadbug (unweighted) worth it as an exercise? Not critical, just want to know the inclusion criteria for it
Had a bike crash Tuesday, hasn’t been able to work out since. Will be going on a biketrip for a week.

The towel whip drill isn’t the one for training the beach volleyball spike technique I don’t think. I at least want to reconsider potential training ways here.
Also the idea of the superset with overhead press and curls were to use the same bar -so it makes no sense for it to be dumbbell curls. Weight seems to fit pretty well, in the sense that I curl the same amount that I shoulder press. Also I would rather have another pull vertical rather than the reverse deck, seeing as the pull-ups are still limited for me and don’t really tire out the vertical pull I don’t feel like.

The towel whip drill was actually a face pull 12.5kg 15 times.
Also it seems like all previous records of weights and logged exercises have gone - what happened there? It says no entry log on exercises I have done multiple times and logged
